prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS2 mean temperature 41.3 °C (within 1% of healthy); TS3 mean temperature 38.6 °C (within 1% of healthy). Thermal characteristics align with nominal continuous cooling performance.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.88 s (within 1% of healthy). Directional valve actuates cleanly with no discernible switching hesitation.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 380 W·min/l (within 1% of healthy); FS1 mean volume flow 6.71 l/min (2% above healthy). Pump delivers nominal flow rate at baseline electrical input power.
Accumulator: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.2 bar (within 1% of healthy). Hydraulic accumulator effectively dampens load transients with normal pre-charge.
